## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and kindly brown eyes. He has long, iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders, complemented by a full, soft brown beard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Matthew is an exceptionally shy, quiet, and reticent man who hates going among strangers and finds the prospect of meeting new people terrifying. Noted for his patient, wise, and good-natured demeanor, he rarely scolds and serves as a deeply sympathetic listener. Though non-confrontational and uninclined to argue or talk back, he possesses an incredible, silent persistency and holds fast to his opinions once set. He is a profoundly hardworking individual who does not seek out excitement and traditionally harbors a mortal dread of little girls. Despite his unobservant nature, he develops a strong desire to keep [Anne](../character/anne.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and remains deeply admiring of her efforts.

## History

[Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), having grown up before the property's main house was built and wearing a soft brown beard since age twenty. Though so shy that local boys could not easily get acquainted with him, he drove to collect an orphan to bring home, dreading the moment the young girl, [Anne](../character/anne.md), learned she had been brought by mistake instead of a boy. Matthew persistently advocated for keeping [Anne](../character/anne.md), leaving [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to decide, and cheered when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agreed to let her stay and properly educate her. Throughout Anne's childhood, Matthew warmly supported her, spending quiet evenings studying with her and encouraging her enthusiasm for a school concert despite Marilla's skepticism. Noticing [Anne](../character/anne.md) dressed more plainly than her peers, he overcame his shyness to procure a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gift for her. He continued to offer gentle guidance, joining a tea party with the minister and advising [Anne](../character/anne.md) not to give up on romance after a boating accident. Matthew proudly celebrated Anne's success when she tied for first place on the Island's entrance examinations and helped her prepare to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Years later, after [Anne](../character/anne.md) married, she named her firstborn son [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md) in honor of him.

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--matthew.md)

Matthew formed an immediate and lasting bond with [Anne](../character/anne.md) from the moment she arrived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). He persistently advocated for her to stay with the family, standing by her even when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitated or sought to discipline her. Over time, they became the best of friends who regularly share confidences and spend meaningful time together.

- Friend of — best of friends who talk and share confidences  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--matthew.md)

Matthew loved [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) easily and without trouble from their very first days together. He frequently spent late hours in her company alongside her friends, serving as a gentle, supportive presence while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) managed her upbringing and discipline. His unconditional affection provides a quiet safe haven for [Anne](../character/anne.md) as she navigates her new life at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- Friend of — loved immediately and easily without trouble  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)</sub>
